column1: # ZAP API scan rule policy of the vampi pack: <pluginId> TAB <IGNORE|WARN|FAIL> TAB (<name>).
# A rules file switches zap-api-scan.py from its API-Minimal policy to every active rule, minus
# the ones set to IGNORE here. IGNORE on an active rule stops it from running, so its alerts leave
# the JSON report; IGNORE on a passive rule only hides it from the console summary, and the alert
# stays in the JSON report that the quality gate counts. Measured with ZAP 2.17.0 (VN-11 to VN-13).
# FAIL: injection and code execution, real vulnerabilities in any API.
# WARN: hygiene seen in both modes, and the answers an attack provoked.
